def sumcifr(x):
    s = 0
    while x!=0:
        s+= x % 10
        x = x // 10
    return s
n = int(input())
c = n
k = 0
a = []
while c != 0:
    if c + sumcifr(c) == n:
        a.append(c)
        k += 1
    c -= 1
print(k)
for i in a:
    print(i)
